what: Design rejected-count parsing is underspecified against the current artifact heading contract
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says to count rejected findings from rejected-findings.md, but current rejected blocks are written as "### [Plan Review] FINDING_N", not "### FINDING_N:". A helper that mirrors the accepted-file regex would emit rejected=0 for valid rejected plan findings, producing wrong rounds JSON.
suggested_fix: In the plan, specify the exact design helper parsers: accepted-plan-findings.md counts "^### FINDING_[0-9]+:"; rejected-findings.md counts "^### \\[Plan Review\\] FINDING_[0-9]+".
